title: Design version: an empty Tech View group reads No work orders assigned
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are active at {Location-A}, and {Technician-A} is pinned in your views.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682434 Ana and ZZAUTOTEST C682434 Ben.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, led by {Technician-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682434 Design Empty.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Type the name of {Customer-A} in "Search".
  2. Look at {Technician-A}'s group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: only {Work-order-1} is listed, in {Technician-B}'s group.
  • Step 2: {Technician-A}'s group is empty and reads "No work orders assigned".

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: Text in an empty Tech View group: the design shows "No work orders assigned"; the PRD says "No work orders". It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D13 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.
